description: This file implements a PHP class for interacting with an SQLite3 database, including connection handling, transaction management, schema introspection, and BLOB operations within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlite3
classes.description: Main driver class for managing SQLite3 database connection, executing queries, handling transactions, and schema-related functions within the ADOdb abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODBRecordset_sqlite3
classes.description: A recordset class for fetching and manipulating query results from SQLite3 databases, supporting various fetch modes.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information such as SQLite version and description.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, or rolls back if an error occurs.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps field types to ADOdb meta types based on SQLite affinity rules.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a specified table.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes driver settings related to transactions and insert ID support.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID from the SQLite connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of affected rows from the last operation.

methods.name: lastError
methods.description: Fetches the last error message and code from the connection.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates a date formatting SQL snippet compatible with SQLite.

methods.name: _createFunctions
methods.description: Registers user-defined functions with the SQLite connection.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a SQLite database file.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Attempts a persistent connection, which in SQLite is the same as a regular connection.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result or false on failure.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID sequence in a table.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence table.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a table.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size of character fields (no limit for SQLite).

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size of text fields (no limit for SQLite).

methods.name: month
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract month from a date field.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract day from a date field.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract year from a date field.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in the database using a prepared statement.

methods.name: updateBlobFile
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field with data read from a file.
